data.title: 塑心 · 大提琴弦上的灵魂放逐
data.action: 双膝轻夹着漆黑的大提琴侧坐，单手持弓悬在琴弦上方，黑白异色头环在发间微光流转，微侧首闭目聆听琴弦共振，嘴角勾起探究人心深处欲望的从容微笑。
data.location: 莱塔尼亚古堡回音大厅，月光透过玫瑰花窗洒在冰冷的大理石地面上
data.timeOfDay: 深夜无人的乐音鸣响之刻
data.lighting: 冷白月光经由哥特花窗滤成幽紫与暗红光柱，将少女白皙的身躯与黑色大提琴融为一体
data.mood: 引导人们直面内心深层欲望与本能的魔性演奏家，优雅、深邃而极度蛊惑
data.description: 莱塔尼亚古堡回音大厅，月光透过玫瑰花窗洒在冰冷的大理石地面上。双膝轻夹着漆黑的大提琴侧坐，单手持弓悬在琴弦上方，黑白异色头环在发间微光流转，微侧首闭目聆听琴弦共振，嘴角勾起探究人心深处欲望的从容微笑。 她微微抬眸轻语——“博士……你的灵魂深处，正奏响着怎样不可告人的旋律呢？别压抑它……在我的琴声里彻底释放吧。”
data.promptProse: Virtuosa sits in an echoing gothic castle hall at midnight, wearing a deep midnight-purple watered-silk slip gown trimmed with black lace whose thigh-high slit parts cleanly around a lacquered black cello held between her knees. With her bow poised over the strings and eyes gently closed in a hypnotic smile, she rests within purple and crimson shafts of stained-glass moonlight.
data.animaCaption: Seated sideways with a polished black cello cradled between her knees through the thigh-high slit of her midnight-purple silk slip gown, she pauses with bow poised above the strings and eyes closed in a serene, entrancing smile. Colored moonlight from tall stained glass washes over the marble hall.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep midnight-purple watered-silk slip gown trimmed with black lace, featuring an open back and a thigh-high side slit parting around her knees.
